properties.description: Diazomethane...ethylene pre-reaction complex (single dot-joined complex node). Clean PM7 minimum found with Opt=(CalcFC,Tight,MaxCyc=300)+Freq started from the reactant-side IRC outer frame: E = 0.1087521022 Ha, 27 real frequencies (3N-6), 0 imaginary, lowest 5.1 cm-1, opt converged, normal termination. Very floppy and weakly bound: 1.6 kcal/mol below separated CH2N2 (0.0891890331) + C2H4 (0.0220771930) = 0.1112662261 Ha. Earlier standard/loose optimizations from other orientations stalled on 1-2 tiny imaginary librational modes.
properties.method: PM7 / Gaussian 16, gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1
properties.assignment_note: The verified complex geometry is written in the symmetry-equivalent fragment labelling: CH2N2 = C4=N3-N2 (C4-N3 1.28 A, N2-N3 1.14 A) and C2H4 = C1=C5 (1.33 A); the site-verified RC node SMILES is unchanged.

properties.description: Asynchronous (diradicaloid) 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition saddle: the imaginary mode at -679.0 cm-1 closes the two ring bonds that are open at the saddle (pair projections C4...C5 0.93, C1...N2 0.90, C1...C4 0.65, N2...C5 0.64), i.e. ring closure is asynchronous rather than synchronous. E = 0.14503399 Ha, exactly one imaginary frequency, opt+freq in one native log. TS geometry: C1-N2 2.137, N3-C4 1.335, C1-C5 1.372, C4-C5 2.192, N2-N3 1.160 A.
properties.connectivity_basis: Connectivity rests on the first-order saddle plus bidirectional IRC interval evidence (calc/step2b/ts2_irc2.log, 25 points each way, normal termination, IRC did not reach its own stopping criterion) plus frequency-verified minima at both outer frames (calc/ep1_src_min2.log, calc/ep1_pz_side.log). Shorter single-direction IRC re-runs (calc/ts1_irc_forward.log ends at 0.0520 Ha next to the 1-pyrazoline minimum; calc/ts1_irc_reverse.log ends at 0.1164 Ha on the dimer side) are consistent with the same two basins; a longer combined IRC (calc/ts1_irc_long.log) error-terminated in the corrector step, so no fully converged IRC exists. The final and cleanest runs are the short-step pair calc/ts1_ircS_forward.log (131 points, reaction coordinate 0 -> 4.461, normal termination, final frame 0.0497127148 Ha) and calc/ts1_ircS_reverse.log (200 points, -6.810 -> 0, normal termination, final frame 0.1108398234 Ha); their outer frames were re-optimized unconstrained, giving calc/ep1_pz_ircS_optfreq.log (0.0497597872 Ha, 27 real modes, 0 imaginary) and calc/ep1_src_ircS_optfreq4.log (0.1087524996 Ha, 27 real modes, 0 imaginary).

properties.description: 1-pyrazoline, planar five-membered ring C1-N2=N3-C4-C5. E = 0.0497598520 Ha; 27 real frequencies (3N-6), lowest 159.7 cm-1, 0 imaginary. The IRC product-side outer frame re-optimizes to the same minimum (calc/ep1_pz_side.log, 0.0497604009 Ha). Only one conformer exists at PM7 (spread <0.05 kcal/mol over three seeds).

N2-extrusion saddle of 1-pyrazoline -> cyclopropane + N2. NOT ACCESSIBLE at the allowed level of theory: closed-shell PM7 (Gaussian 16 RPM7) yields no concerted cheletropic extrusion saddle on this surface. Two Opt=(TS,CalcFC,NoEigentest) searches in the extrusion region converged to retro-1,3-dipolar cleavage saddles instead (calc/step2b/ts2_opt2.log -679.0 cm-1; calc/step2b/ts2_opt5.log -595.1 cm-1, whose IRC runs to CH2N2 + C2H4); all other starts rolled downhill to the cyclopropane...N2 minimum. Constrained PM7 scans give extrusion crests of +70.3 (1D C1-N2, ring intact), +96.6 (2D C1-N2/C1-C4 ridge) and >150 kcal/mol (forced C1-C4 closure with the ring intact). No bound stepwise/diradical intermediate on the closed-shell singlet surface.
properties.accessible_note: no trustworthy saddle; exploratory scans and failed saddle searches only, so no barrier is declared
properties.diradical_channel_check: Diradical channel tested and excluded at this level: (a) unrestricted triplet PM7 (UPM7, mult 3) optimization started from the 1-pyrazoline geometry gives E = 0.1542087 Ha, i.e. +65.5 kcal/mol above the singlet pyrazoline minimum, and it is not even a minimum (2 imaginary frequencies) - calc/dirad_triplet.log; (b) a broken-symmetry singlet single point (guess=(mix,always), UPM7 seed) at the extrusion-region saddle geometry collapses back to the closed-shell solution (E = 0.17682749 Ha, identical to the RHF value) - calc/dirad_bsse.log. So the closed-shell singlet solution is stable against symmetry breaking and no low-lying diradical intermediate exists.
properties.untried_or_blocked: Two follow-ups that the earlier consultation asked for before declaring the step inaccessible could not be completed under the active method policy: (a) an unconstrained broken-symmetry open-shell singlet optimization (PM7, mult 1, guess=(mix,always), from the ring-opened frame of ts2_scan2Dfine.log) was rejected by the compute policy (policy_blocked) - only closed-shell PM7 is allowed, so an open-shell-singlet diradical intermediate cannot be characterised here; (b) a 2D relaxed PM7 scan opening both C1-N2 and N3-C4 simultaneously (calc/pz_open_scan2D.log, B 1 2 S 8 0.2 / B 3 4 S 8 0.2) error-terminated: the constrained relaxation at the first scan point hit the step cap (NStep=66, max force 5.1e-2) and the job died in l9999. Together with the triplet UPM7 result (not a minimum, 2 imaginary modes) and the RHF collapse of the broken-symmetry single point, no accessible route to a bound open-shell intermediate was found.
properties.formal_workflow_attempt: The formal TS workflow (ts_prepare run ts_0002) was run twice with the workflow's own atom map: GFN2-xTB path refinements of 100 and then 300 runs produced no valid saddle guess - the first hit the refinement cap without convergence, the second produced a candidate that failed validation because it did not place the declared reaction centre (workflow-derived pairs (2,3),(2,5),(4,5) in its own numbering) in a plausible range (ts/ts_0002/process.json, path-task.chem-result.json). The workflow was then stopped (ts_stop) as a recorded negative result.

properties.description: Cyclopropane + N2. The shallow cyclopropane...N2 contact is a genuine but very floppy PM7 minimum: E = 0.07030398 Ha, 27 real frequencies (lowest 7.7 cm-1), 0.89 kcal/mol below separated cyclopropane (0.0191473575 Ha) + N2 (0.0525726877 Ha) = 0.0717200452 Ha.

Separated-asymptote reference for the competing retro-1,3-dipolar cleavage: diazomethane + ethylene, each a verified PM7 minimum (0.0891890331 + 0.0220771930 = 0.1112662261 Ha). This is NOT the pre-reaction complex: node RC ('C=[N+]=[N-].C=C', same dot-joined SMILES string by schema convention) is a distinct bound minimum 1.6 kcal/mol lower at 0.1087521022 Ha, and the IRC of the retro edge passes through that complex minimum before reaching this asymptote.
properties.role_note: reference asymptote, not a complex minimum

properties.barrier_reference: lowest verified reactant minimum = the diazomethane...ethylene pre-reaction complex, E(RC) = 0.1087521022 Ha (calc/ep1_src_min2.log, 0 imaginary, started from the IRC outer frame)
properties.barrier_calculation: (0.14503399 - 0.10875210) Ha = 0.03628189 Ha = 22.8 kcal/mol (electronic PM7, no ZPE, no thermal correction); using the outer-frame-consistent complex minimum calc/ep1_src_ircS_optfreq4.log (0.1087524996 Ha) the same barrier is (0.14503399 - 0.10875250) Ha = 0.03628149 Ha = 22.8 kcal/mol, i.e. the two complex minima differ by only 0.00025 kcal/mol
properties.endpoint_reoptimization: Both IRC outer frames were re-optimized unconstrained from the exact native outer-frame geometries: calc/ep1_pz_ircS_optfreq.log (1-pyrazoline, 0.0497597872 Ha, 27 real, 0 imaginary, converged in 3 steps) and calc/ep1_src_ircS_optfreq4.log (CH2N2...C2H4 complex, 0.1087524996 Ha, 27 real, 0 imaginary, lowest 6.0 cm-1, converged in 42 steps with Opt=(CalcAll); Opt=(CalcFC,Tight/MaxCycle=250/400) stopped at the 100-step cap on this very flat dimer surface, so CalcAll was used)
properties.assignment_note: The declared break/form lists use the user's atom map ([CH2:1]=[N+:2]=[N-:3].[CH2:4]=[CH2:5]) and are the correct net change for the declared RC and 1-pyrazoline SMILES. The computed RC/TS1/IRC structures are written in the symmetry-equivalent mirror labelling (diazomethane C4=N3-N2, ethylene C1=C5; N2/N3 exchanged). The 1-pyrazoline ring is invariant under that exchange (C4-N3=N2-C1-C5 == C1-N2=N3-C4-C5), so it is the same chemical species and the same elementary step, but the submitted IRC geometry literally shows the mirrored pairing.
properties.irc_limitation: Bidirectional IRC (calc/step2b/ts2_irc2.log) transfers 25 points each way with ends 0.43 and 4.2 kcal/mol above the two verified minima. Extended/alternative runs tried: stepsize 3/120 points (calc/ts1_ircL_forward.log -> 0.049723 Ha at the 1-pyrazoline minimum; calc/ts1_ircL_reverse.log -> 0.110715 Ha near the dimer minimum); stepsize 5/40 points (calc/ts1_irc5_forward.log -> 0.049765 Ha); HPC corrector (calc/ts1_ircHPC_forward.log, aborts); and finally stepsize 1/200 points (calc/ts1_ircS_forward.log, 131 points, normal termination, ends 0.049713 Ha at the 1-pyrazoline minimum; calc/ts1_ircS_reverse.log, 200 points, normal termination, ends 0.110840 Ha near the dimer minimum). Every long trace reaches the basins; the shorter-step runs terminate normally instead of aborting in the corrector. The harness 'short_irc' flag still reports incomplete even with this normally terminated pair and with endpoint Opt logs started from those very outer frames; both directions stop short of the exact basins because the Gaussian IRC corrector errors on the very flat dimer surface, so connectivity is documented through the saddle + bidirectional roughly-terminated IRC pair + frequency-verified outer-frame minima, as the Supervisor accepted.

properties.accessible_note: no trustworthy TS2 at closed-shell PM7; the edge is retained for mechanism topology but no barrier is claimed
properties.measured_upper_bounds: constrained PM7 crests: +70.3 kcal/mol (1D C1-N2 stretch, ring intact), +96.6 (2D C1-N2/C1-C4 ridge), >150 (forced C1-C4 closure); reaction energy 1-pyrazoline -> cyclopropane + N2 = +13.8 kcal/mol
properties.explored_and_excluded: concerted synchronous and asynchronous Opt=(TS,CalcFC) searches from IDPP images, the 2D-ridge point, the product complex and the reverse-scan crest; 1D and 2D constrained PM7 scans; triplet UPM7 and broken-symmetry singlet checks. All of them fail to give an N2-extrusion saddle at closed-shell PM7.

edges.channel: competing retro-1,3-dipolar cleavage (shares the same saddle with e1 in the opposite direction)

properties.relationship: e3 and e1 are the same elementary saddle traversed in opposite directions; e3 is the competing channel, not an independent step.
properties.irc_endpoint_note: the preserved IRC connects 1-pyrazoline to the bound diazomethane...ethylene complex minimum (calc/ep1_src_min2.log, 0.1087521022 Ha, node RC), which lies 1.6 kcal/mol below this separated asymptote SEP
